column6: The base class for datatypes that have values that are restriced to a set of literals or tokens. The members of the restriction may themselve be restriced by facets that apply to scalar data types.
A datatype that is the union of numeric xsd data types. "numericUnion" is equivalent to the xsd specification that uses an xsd:union of memberTypes="xsd:decimal xsd:double xsd:float xsd:integer".
